mentions.name: Obsidian to Astro notes pipeline
mentions.description: This pipeline converts Obsidian markdown notes into a format Astro understands for publishing blogs and notes, since Astro doesn't natively support Obsidian markdown syntax; it is built around working with ASTs.
mentions.problem: Astro doesn't understand Obsidian markdown syntax, so there was no good pipeline for publishing Obsidian notes to an Astro blog.
mentions.source_excerpt: Wanted a good Obsidian -> Astro blog/notes pipeline since Astro doesn't understand Obsidian markdown syntax, wrapping my head around ASTs for that.

evidence.value: Wanted a good Obsidian -> Astro blog/notes pipeline since Astro doesn't understand Obsidian markdown syntax, wrapping my head around ASTs for that.
